inResponseTo: Lead static reconciliation found two further concrete in-lease defects in tests/box/delegation/environment-host.mjs: (1) controller('stage') was a no-op placeholder instead of a deterministic manifest-bound stage mode; (2) the host/supervision boundary was inconsistent -- environmentPlan advertised per-command docker exec argv (runnerEntryArgv) while superviseBatch() ran superviseInner locally, leaving a callable host function that would silently execute product commands on the Windows host and leaving no fixed route to retrieve/validate durable inner records.

changes: controller('stage'): replaced the no-op placeholder with a deterministic implementation. It reads the fixed manifest-bound root allowlist m.stage.sourceStaging.roots (validated: non-empty array, <=64 unique entries, each passed through assertStageableRel), walks it under the module-derived source root (resolve(dirname(SELF_PATH),'..','..','..'), realpath-canonicalized) in sorted readdir order, prunes FORBIDDEN_STAGE_SEGMENTS/.env* entries during the walk, rejects symlinks and non-regular/non-directory entries, and hands the exact {source, rel} inventory to the reviewed stageFiles(STAGE_ROOT, files) path. All existing defenses are preserved: assertStageRoot pins the fixed owned STAGE_ROOT, assertStageableRel per segment, canonical root/ancestor/final symlink checks (assertNoSymlinkAncestors/realRoot/assertReceiptTarget family), regular-file-only sources, per-file sha256 digests, exclusive 'wx' writes, and no unchecked whole-root 'cp .'. Delivery to the runner remains the separate reviewed stageCopyArgv() 'docker cp <STAGE_ROOT>/. <runner>:/stage' transport step; no actual staging was performed.

controller('supervise'): replaced the always-throwing branch with a coherent fixed host-side batch route. It issues exactly one fixed argv via runCapture('docker', runnerBatchArgv()) = docker exec --workdir /stage w005-d12-delegation-runner node /stage/tests/box/delegation/environment-host.mjs batch, then retrieves each durable inner record via the fixed runnerResultArgv(i) route and validates index/commandHash/state before considering a command complete. Docker exec exit status is treated as transport evidence only; a transport failure is captured and reported but inner record validation still runs. If any record is unavailable, mismatched, non-'completed', or lacks a numeric exitCode, the mode throws environment_supervision_failed with bounded evidence. No host path executes product commands locally.

Added runnerBatchArgv() and runnerResultArgv(index): fixed Docker exec argv builders (assertFixedArgv, index range-checked against ALLOWED_COMMANDS) for the new inner 'batch' and 'result <i>' entry modes. runnerEntryArgv(index) is retained as the fixed per-command route for reconciled single-index resume.

Added commandRecordDescriptor(index): single source of truth for {index, command, commandHash, recordRel} where commandHash = sha256Json({index, command}).slice(0,24), matching the naming superviseInner already uses for command-<i>-<hash>.json receipts.

main(): added two fixed inner entry modes alongside 'supervise <i>': (a) 'batch' runs superviseBatch over all 8 fixed indices in order with leaseOwner 'w005-d12-delegation-runner', receiptRoot RUNNER_RECEIPT_DIR and the fixed innerCountRunDatabases counter -- preserving sequential order, 305s legacy-auth idle, the >=12/unknown run-database budget gate, ledger interruption fail-closed resume, PGID/descendant handling and digest-addressed stdout/stderr records; (b) 'result <i>' resolves the durable record for the exact index/hash through assertReceiptTarget(RUNNER_RECEIPT_DIR, recordRel) (real-dir, no symlink ancestors, regular-file only), verifies record.index/record.commandHash, and prints redactSecrets(record) to stdout. No arbitrary paths or shell strings are accepted anywhere; the unrecognized-argv error text was updated to name the three accepted modes.

Added innerCountRunDatabases(): fixed psql argv (-X -A -t -c <fixed dual-prefix count SQL> <BOX_DELEGATION_DATABASE_URL>) returning an integer count or 'unknown' on any transport/spawn/parse failure; 'unknown' hits the existing fail-closed budget gate, so an unavailable counter refuses rather than skips the cap check.

environmentPlan: supervise phase argv is now [runnerBatchArgv()] (the actual host route) with a note documenting the inner batch semantics, the result-route retrieval and the retained per-command runnerEntryArgv resume route.

stage.sourceStaging.roots: added the fixed 19-entry source-root allowlist (package.json, pnpm-workspace.yaml, pnpm-lock.yaml, tsconfig.json, scripts, tests, services, apps, packages, db, infra, tasks, templates, examples, docs, AGENTS.md, README.md, START.md, PLAN.md) plus rootsNote describing the deterministic enumeration and that dependency code reaches /stage only via the two fixed read-only dependency mounts. Truly needed: without a manifest-bound inventory the stage mode could only defer to an unreviewed caller or accept arbitrary input.

commands.supervision.hostBatchRoute: documented the single fixed docker exec batch route, the fixed 'result <i>' retrieval/validation route, transport-vs-authoritative-evidence split and the retained 'supervise <i>' resume route.

intendedPostReleaseInvocationRoute: Root-side sequence after setup release: controller('plan') review -> controller('ledger') -> controller('create', {dbPassword}) -> controller('start') -> controller('verify') (account/user/network gates) -> controller('stage') (deterministic manifest-bound host staging into STAGE_ROOT, then the reviewed stageCopyArgv docker cp into the /stage tmpfs) -> controller('supervise') (one fixed docker exec 'batch' inside the runner; inner superviseBatch enforces order/idle/cap/durable evidence; host then validates all 8 durable records via fixed 'result <i>' execs) -> controller('verify'). Inner-only entry modes: 'supervise <i>' (reconciled single-index resume via runnerEntryArgv), 'batch', 'result <i>'. superviseBatch remains the inner orchestrator also called by the leased fixture-registration.test.ts cap regression inside the runner.

commandsRunThisRound.command: sha256sum on all 23 leased product paths

unperformed: No runtime, tests, typecheck, build, browser, DB, Docker create/exec, staging or tmpfs actions; root has not released setup/runtime. No actual staging was performed by the new stage mode.
No commits/pushes, no governance/cto/state writes, no comments added or removed in code, no dependency/config/security/auth-policy edits, no new product paths or agents.
knownLimitations: innerCountRunDatabases uses a fixed psql argv inside the runner; if psql is absent from the runner image or the URL is unreachable it returns 'unknown', which hits the existing fail-closed budget gate and refuses rather than skips the cap check. Static review cannot confirm psql availability in image sha256:eb4a...; reviewer may prefer pg-client-via-node_modules or treating the counter as optional.

stage.sourceStaging.roots is a new manifest-bound allowlist chosen to cover the 8 fixed commands' workspace needs (scripts/tests/services/apps/packages/db plus config manifests and docs/tasks/templates/infra/examples); it prunes forbidden segments during the walk and stageFiles rejects anything non-regular, so it cannot stage node_modules/.git/.runtime/dist/.env* even if listed. Reviewer should confirm the root set is sufficient and not overbroad.

controller('supervise') is host-side only; the inner 'batch'/'result' modes are unreachable on the host except via the fixed docker exec argv, and superviseInner/superviseBatch retain their receiptRoot whitelist. Windows-local execution of product commands remains impossible through any exported route.
Only environment-host.mjs and environment-manifest.json changed vs correction-receipt-7; all 21 other leased paths byte-identical.
